brand.promptPrefix: YourBrand: [palette description]. Match attached app icon style.

concepts.prompt: Square 1:1 app icon, rounded corners. [Direction A: palette + metaphor]. No text.
Square 1:1 app icon, rounded corners. [Direction B: different visual world]. No text.

brandGuide.prompt: Brand guide cheat sheet poster. Palette swatches, typography, UI mocks, icon usage. Figma brand board — no people.

promo.prompt: Small promo tile. Wordmark + hero visual + tagline.
Wide marquee. Headline left, hero visual right.

screenshots.prompt: Promo slide 1 — hero value prop. NOT a literal screenshot.
Promo slide 2 — 3-step how it works. NOT a literal screenshot.
Promo slide 3 — key benefit before/after. NOT a literal screenshot.
Promo slide 4 — feature depth. NOT a literal screenshot.
Promo slide 5 — comparison or formats. NOT a literal screenshot.
